note: USFS Kootenai NF (Three Rivers RD), at Kilbrennan Lake northwest of Troy via Kilbrennan Lake Rd 2394, ~2,900 ft. Native-soil roads and spurs; boat ramp for smaller boats, lake fishing. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Apr 30, 2026) confirms $10 with 50% Senior/Access discount, 7 sites, vault toilets, no potable water; added season year-round (managed Memorial Day-Labor Day). Page silent on FCFS, stay limit and length (derived FCFS, 16 days, 24 ft left). No alert for road 2394.
